allow: PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 13; $p = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/people" -UseBasicParsing\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output \("body types served: " + \($p.types.body -join ", "\)\); foreach \($per in $p.people\) { Write-Output \("--- track " + $per.track_id + " | dom=" + $per.dominant_type + " ---"\); $sp = $per.seizure_probabilities; foreach \($k in $sp.PSObject.Properties.Name\) { Write-Output \("  " + $k.PadRight\(20\) + " = " + $sp.$k\) } })

PowerShell(.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -c "import cv2; c = cv2.VideoCapture\('eyelid-seizure.MOV'\); print\('opened=', c.isOpened\(\)\); print\('fps=', c.get\(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS\)\); print\('frames=', int\(c.get\(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT\)\)\); print\('size=', int\(c.get\(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH\)\), 'x', int\(c.get\(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT\)\)\); c.release\(\)")
